messages.content: The centering on this card is way off for a PSA 7. I've seen PSA 5s with better centering.
PSA grades on multiple factors - centering is just one element. Surface, corners, and edges also matter.
I understand that, but this centering would typically cap the grade. There's also a print line I can see through the case.
Print lines are common on vintage cards and graders account for them. PSA's professionals determined this is a 7. I can't change their assessment.
